messages.subject: Project Solstice - engagement letter
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Alice,

Great to speak earlier. As discussed, please find attached our engagement letter for the Series A round (internally Project Solstice). James Osei will lead day-to-day, supervised by me.

Our fee estimate is £48,000-£56,000 plus VAT; separately the Company has agreed under the term sheet to bear Ardent's legal fees up to £35,000 plus VAT. If you're happy, please sign and return.

Best,

Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
